_readme: Talaash Heritage's own photographs from past programmes. build_catalogue.py shows them on the programme pages listed under 'pages' (a 'From our walks' block); the home page uses them too. Use wide shots where people are small or seen from behind; leave out close-ups of faces, especially children. Every entry must say which event it is from, checked against the original post.

events.title: From our evening walk at the Qutb complex
events.caption: Our evening walk at the Qutb complex on 26 June 2022. More than 20 people joined.

photos.alt: People on a Talaash Heritage evening walk gather in front of the arched stone screen of the Quwwat-ul-Islam mosque in the Qutb complex, at dusk.
The walk leader points out the floodlit ruins of the Qutb complex to the group at dusk.
The walk leader, in a blue sari, talks to the group beside a stone wall in the Qutb complex in the evening sun.
